title: Lithic trust bento
description: Four faint-bronze cards with 24px corners in two unequal rows (wide + narrow, then narrow + wide): a medium heading in each, dark-bronze sub-lines, rows of partner names, a round badge slot, and faint contour rings in two corners. One column on phones.
notes: takes exactly four cards: desktop places 1 and 2 on the first row, 4 then 3 on the second (the phone order is 1, 2, 3, 4)
partner names are text marks; the badge is a media slot (112px circle placeholder)
